sections.text_helper: Section 9.1 "Boot after system reset" in chapter 9 (Boot modes), RM0486 Rev 4, page 286.
sections.section_content:
The ROM code is the first code executed after any system reset.
The boot mode is determined by BOOT0 and BOOT1 pins, and one OTP word.
• BOOT0 is a dedicated pin that is latched when reset is released.
• BOOT1 is a non-dedicated boot pin. Its value is taken either from BOOT1 pin (default
pin PA6), or from another pin defined by OTP19 bit[24:21] dev_boot_port and bit[28:25]
dev_boot_pin.
The final hardware design must ensure that both BOOT0 and BOOT1 pins are physically
accessible.
